* Refuse `cloud service query --query` when data is waiting on stdin by @sdairs in https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhousectl/pull/647
* Refuse `clickpipe settings` on database CDC pipes instead of relaying NOT_FOUND by @sdairs in https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhousectl/pull/648
* Name the 30-second Query API limit and hint the native client on a gateway timeout by @sdairs in https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhousectl/pull/649
* Expose destination roles on `clickpipe create` (`--role`) by @sdairs in https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhousectl/pull/650
* Expose Postgres CDC pipe settings on `clickpipe create postgres` by @sdairs in https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhousectl/pull/651
* Expose per-table mapping options on `clickpipe create postgres` by @sdairs in https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhousectl/pull/652
* clickpipe schema-discover: support object storage sources by @sdairs in https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhousectl/pull/653
* Add Google Cloud Pub/Sub ClickPipe source support by @sdairs in https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhousectl/pull/654
* Add `clickpipe reverse-private-endpoint` management commands by @sdairs in https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhous
